decks.domain: Class E licensing and identity documents

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A Louisiana resident who drives on the _____ ’s public streets or highways needs a Louisiana driver license.
cards.back: A Louisiana resident who drives on the state’s public streets or highways needs a Louisiana driver license.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Keep your driver _____ with you whenever you drive.
cards.back: Keep your driver license with you whenever you drive.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: When an officer asks to inspect your driver license, you _____ show it.
cards.back: When an officer asks to inspect your driver license, you must show it.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A new Louisiana resident has _____ days after establishing residency to obtain a Louisiana license.
cards.back: A new Louisiana resident has thirty days after establishing residency to obtain a Louisiana license.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A nonresident with a valid license from another state may drive in Louisiana for _____ days without obtaining a Louisiana license.
cards.back: A nonresident with a valid license from another state may drive in Louisiana for ninety days without obtaining a Louisiana license.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A nonresident student is exempt from obtaining a Louisiana license when carrying both a valid home-_____ license and a current student identification card.
cards.back: A nonresident student is exempt from obtaining a Louisiana license when carrying both a valid home-state license and a current student identification card.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Temporarily operating a farm tractor, farm implement or road machinery on a highway does _____ require obtaining a Louisiana driver license.
cards.back: Temporarily operating a farm tractor, farm implement or road machinery on a highway does not require obtaining a Louisiana driver license.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: An Armed Forces member operating a United States government vehicle on official duty does _____ need a Louisiana license for that operation.
cards.back: An Armed Forces member operating a United States government vehicle on official duty does not need a Louisiana license for that operation.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Resident service members and their resident military dependents are exempt from obtaining a Louisiana license while holding a valid license from their home _____ .
cards.back: Resident service members and their resident military dependents are exempt from obtaining a Louisiana license while holding a valid license from their home state.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The license class you _____ depends on the vehicle you will operate and whether driving is the main purpose of your employment.
cards.back: The license class you need depends on the vehicle you will operate and whether driving is the main purpose of your employment.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Class E covers a single motor vehicle weighing under _____ pounds, recreational vehicles, and qualifying farm vehicles outside the commercial-vehicle definition.
cards.back: Class E covers a single motor vehicle weighing under ten thousand one pounds, recreational vehicles, and qualifying farm vehicles outside the commercial-vehicle definition.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A Temporary Instruction Permit is limited to a student’s use while enrolled in _____ education or a pre-licensing course.
cards.back: A Temporary Instruction Permit is limited to a student’s use while enrolled in driver education or a pre-licensing course.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Louisiana does not allow a person to hold more than _____ driver license.
cards.back: Louisiana does not allow a person to hold more than one driver license.

decks.domain: Class E licensing and identity documents

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Louisiana licenses and identification cards _____ use the applicant’s complete legal name.
cards.back: Louisiana licenses and identification cards must use the applicant’s complete legal name.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Identity papers must be _____ or copies certified by the department that keeps the record.
cards.back: Identity papers must be originals or copies certified by the department that keeps the record.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A photocopy is not acceptable identification even when a notary has _____ it.
cards.back: A photocopy is not acceptable identification even when a notary has certified it.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The first-time applicant document list permits _____ primary document with two secondary documents, or two primary documents.
cards.back: The first-time applicant document list permits one primary document with two secondary documents, or two primary documents.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Additional identification is _____ when a Louisiana identification card clearly identifies the applicant by photograph and the file already contains the Social Security number.
cards.back: Additional identification is unnecessary when a Louisiana identification card clearly identifies the applicant by photograph and the file already contains the Social Security number.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: An applicant eligible for a Social Security number _____ provide the assigned number when applying for a license.
cards.back: An applicant eligible for a Social Security number must provide the assigned number when applying for a license.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The Social Security number goes into the licensing department’s internal file rather than onto the _____ face.
cards.back: The Social Security number goes into the licensing department’s internal file rather than onto the license face.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: An applicant without an assigned Social Security number _____ obtain an official Social Security Administration letter stating that none was assigned or that the applicant is ineligible.
cards.back: An applicant without an assigned Social Security number must obtain an official Social Security Administration letter stating that none was assigned or that the applicant is ineligible.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide requires male United States citizens or immigrants aged _____ through twenty-six to provide their Social Security number for a license or identification card, and says refusal prevents issuance.
cards.back: The guide requires male United States citizens or immigrants aged fifteen through twenty-six to provide their Social Security number for a license or identification card, and says refusal prevents issuance.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The _____ -document birth-record list includes an original birth certificate or a certified birth-certificate copy, and says a short-form birth card does not need a seal.
cards.back: The primary-document birth-record list includes an original birth certificate or a certified birth-certificate copy, and says a short-form birth card does not need a seal.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A birth-registration record from a _____ or county vital-statistics bureau is included among primary identity documents.
cards.back: A birth-registration record from a state or county vital-statistics bureau is included among primary identity documents.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The primary identity list includes a _____ Department certificate documenting a birth abroad.
cards.back: The primary identity list includes a State Department certificate documenting a birth abroad.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A naturalization certificate is included in the _____ identity list.
cards.back: A naturalization certificate is included in the primary identity list.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A Native American tribal document is included in the _____ identity list.
cards.back: A Native American tribal document is included in the primary identity list.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A United States passport book or passport card may serve as a _____ document.
cards.back: A United States passport book or passport card may serve as a primary document.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: An applicant _____ or younger using a passport must also present a certified birth certificate or papers establishing custody or legal guardianship.
cards.back: An applicant seventeen or younger using a passport must also present a certified birth certificate or papers establishing custody or legal guardianship.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A foreign passport used as a _____ document needs the appropriate stamp and accompanying immigration papers.
cards.back: A foreign passport used as a primary document needs the appropriate stamp and accompanying immigration papers.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The _____ immigration-document list includes a permanent resident card, a Homeland Security refugee travel document or a Homeland Security permit to reenter the United States.
cards.back: The primary immigration-document list includes a permanent resident card, a Homeland Security refugee travel document or a Homeland Security permit to reenter the United States.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide’s _____ military-document list includes a current United States military identification card, dependent identification, a draft record, separation record, Selective Service notification or Coast Guard Merchant Mariner card.
cards.back: The guide’s primary military-document list includes a current United States military identification card, dependent identification, a draft record, separation record, Selective Service notification or Coast Guard Merchant Mariner card.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The name on a secondary identification document should match the name on the _____ document.
cards.back: The name on a secondary identification document should match the name on the primary document.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: An out-of-_____ motor-vehicle agency’s license or identification card may be secondary identification when its photograph clearly identifies the person.
cards.back: An out-of-state motor-vehicle agency’s license or identification card may be secondary identification when its photograph clearly identifies the person.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: If an applicant has lost an out-of-_____ license, the guide requires an official driving record from the last state that issued it.
cards.back: If an applicant has lost an out-of-state license, the guide requires an official driving record from the last state that issued it.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A foreign driver license _____ be accompanied by the appropriate immigration documents.
cards.back: A foreign driver license must be accompanied by the appropriate immigration documents.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Social Security _____ may use the Social Security card, official verification from the Social Security Administration or verbal verification.
cards.back: Social Security verification may use the Social Security card, official verification from the Social Security Administration or verbal verification.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The secondary photo-identification list includes Louisiana school identification, law-_____ identification, qualifying employer identification and identification from government agencies or Louisiana correctional authorities.
cards.back: The secondary photo-identification list includes Louisiana school identification, law-enforcement identification, qualifying employer identification and identification from government agencies or Louisiana correctional authorities.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The _____ identification list also includes a Transportation Worker Identification Credential or a Homeland Security employment-authorization document.
cards.back: The secondary identification list also includes a Transportation Worker Identification Credential or a Homeland Security employment-authorization document.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: For secondary identification, an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter needs the agency director’s signature and a raised seal, and lasts _____ days from issuance.
cards.back: For secondary identification, an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter needs the agency director’s signature and a raised seal, and lasts fifteen days from issuance.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: High-school, college or university educational diplomas, certificates or licenses appear in the _____ -document list.
cards.back: High-school, college or university educational diplomas, certificates or licenses appear in the secondary-document list.

decks.domain: Class E licensing and identity documents

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: For an applicant aged _____ or younger, a custodial parent or legal guardian must sign for license issuance, duplicate issuance and restriction changes.
cards.back: For an applicant aged seventeen or younger, a custodial parent or legal guardian must sign for license issuance, duplicate issuance and restriction changes.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Both the minor applicant and the parent or guardian _____ present identification.
cards.back: Both the minor applicant and the parent or guardian must present identification.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: When parents have joint custody, only the _____ parent may sign the minor’s application.
cards.back: When parents have joint custody, only the domiciliary parent may sign the minor’s application.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The minor’s licensing application also _____ the custody documents.
cards.back: The minor’s licensing application also requires the custody documents.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: First-license applicants must finish the _____ driver education and show proof before applying for the license.
cards.back: First-license applicants must finish the required driver education and show proof before applying for the license.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A Temporary Instruction Permit must be obtained _____ a knowledge test, a skills test or any behind-the-wheel instruction.
cards.back: A Temporary Instruction Permit must be obtained before a knowledge test, a skills test or any behind-the-wheel instruction.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A Class E learner-permit applicant must be at least _____ and complete every applicable graduated-licensing stage.
cards.back: A Class E learner-permit applicant must be at least fifteen and complete every applicable graduated-licensing stage.

decks.domain: Class E licensing and identity documents

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide treats a permanent resident card issued after July _____ as primary identification, together with Social Security verification and a secondary document.
cards.back: The guide treats a permanent resident card issued after July nineteen ninety-seven as primary identification, together with Social Security verification and a secondary document.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide treats a permanent resident card issued before July _____ as secondary identification, so it also calls for a primary document and Social Security verification.
cards.back: The guide treats a permanent resident card issued before July nineteen ninety-seven as secondary identification, so it also calls for a primary document and Social Security verification.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: For the listed foreign-passport substitution, the guide requires a stamp showing that the arrival record was surrendered for permanent-resident processing, an employment-authorization card, Social Security _____ and a secondary document.
cards.back: For the listed foreign-passport substitution, the guide requires a stamp showing that the arrival record was surrendered for permanent-resident processing, an employment-authorization card, Social Security verification and a secondary document.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: In that foreign-passport substitution, a stamp less than _____ months old permits issuance according to the guide, while a stamp more than nine months old does not.
cards.back: In that foreign-passport substitution, a stamp less than nine months old permits issuance according to the guide, while a stamp more than nine months old does not.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide lists an application to adjust to lawful permanent residence, Social Security _____ and a secondary document as another identification combination.
cards.back: The guide lists an application to adjust to lawful permanent residence, Social Security verification and a secondary document as another identification combination.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The older resident-alien card designated I-_____ is no longer accepted as proof of identity or status in the guide.
cards.back: The older resident-alien card designated I-one hundred fifty-one is no longer accepted as proof of identity or status in the guide.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A refugee must present an arrival record establishing refugee status and _____ secondary documents, and should also present an available passport with the employment-authorization card.
cards.back: A refugee must present an arrival record establishing refugee status and two secondary documents, and should also present an available passport with the employment-authorization card.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide accepts an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter with a color photograph for _____ days after issuance.
cards.back: The guide accepts an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter with a color photograph for fifteen days after issuance.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A nonimmigrant applicant’s listed documents are a foreign passport with an arrival record showing immigration status, Social Security _____ and a secondary document.
cards.back: A nonimmigrant applicant’s listed documents are a foreign passport with an arrival record showing immigration status, Social Security verification and a secondary document.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A student holding an F-_____ , J-one or M-one status must present the student document that identifies the school, program duration and school representative contact details.
cards.back: A student holding an F-one, J-one or M-one status must present the student document that identifies the school, program duration and school representative contact details.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide requires at least _____ days of remaining visa or arrival-record validity before issuing a license or identification card, and denies issuance when less time remains.
cards.back: The guide requires at least thirty days of remaining visa or arrival-record validity before issuing a license or identification card, and denies issuance when less time remains.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A person who is _____ a Louisiana resident is not eligible for a Louisiana driver license or identification card.
cards.back: A person who is not a Louisiana resident is not eligible for a Louisiana driver license or identification card.
